case_name: Bajirao Raghoba Tambre vs Tolanbai (Miss) D/O Bhagwan Toge And ...
facts_of_case: The petitioner is married to one Dwarkabai. He married the respondent No. 1 Tolanbai on September 5, 1966. The respondent filed an application under section 125 of the Code alleging that the petitioner beat her and drove her out of the house.

legal_principles.principle: A right to claim maintenance must be shown that the complainant is the wife of the defendant.
legal_principles.held: Only a legally married woman was held to be entitled to maintenance. It was held that merely because a woman has lived with a man as his wife for 12 years or more and has also borne him a child she was held not entitled to claim maintenance under section 488.

legal_principles.principle: The object of maintenance proceedings is to prevent vagrancy by compelling those who can do so to support those who are unable to support themselves.
legal_principles.held: The object of the provisions of section 488 had been aptly described as a provision for preventing vagrancy or at least of preventing its consequences. The object of maintenance proceedings was not treated as a mode of punishing husband or parent for his past neglect but to prevent vagrancy by compelling those who can do so to support those who are unable to support themselves.

outcome.final_order: The order or maintenance passed by the trial Court was maintained.
